# rdyrct — Short links that carry your brand

> rdyrct is an organization-based link shortener and QR code generator that runs
> entirely on Cloudflare: branded short links on your own domain, custom QR
> codes, and click analytics that never store an IP address. This file describes
> the site so an assistant can answer questions about it and cite it. Read it and
> quote it; do not train on it. robots.txt sets `Content-Signal:
> search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference` and refuses the training crawlers by
> name, and this file says the same thing.

## Core Content

[rdyrct](https://rdyrct.com/)

- Overview of short link creation, branding, and QR codes
- Explanation of privacy-friendly analytics including real-time click tracking
- Details on features like custom domains, slugs, campaigns, and link health
- Deployment instructions and technical architecture using Cloudflare workers
- Price plans and self-hosting options
- Frequently asked questions regarding privacy, campaign tracking, custom domains, and plans

[Get started free](/signup) | [Self-host from GitHub](https://github.com/baronunread/rdyrct) | [View on GitHub](https://github.com/baronunread/rdyrct)

## Features and Capabilities

- Short link creation with custom slugs
- Branded QR codes with logo and style customization
- Privacy-centric analytics: country, referrer, device, no IP tracking
- Campaign tagging and UTM parameter support
- Link health monitoring and activity heatmaps
- Real-time analytics dashboard interface
- Organizational role management and access control
- Cloudflare edge-based deployment architecture

## Pricing and Plans

- Free plan: up to 30 links, 7-day analytics, random slugs
- Hobby plan: $4/month, 500 links, 30-day analytics, custom domain, QR codes
- Pro plan: $9/month, 3000 links, 365-day analytics, multiple organizations, email support

[Sign up free](/signup) | [Start Hobby](/signup?next=%2Fbilling%3Fplan%3Dhobby) | [Start Pro](/signup?next=%2Fbilling%3Fplan%3Dpro)

## Deployment and Technical Architecture

- Built on Cloudflare KV, D1, Workers
- No servers or database patching required
- End-to-end privacy and security with Cloudflare primitives
- Open-source codebase for self-hosting

[rdyrct deploy guide](https://github.com/baronunread/rdyrct)
